body:
From what I can see, the limit you're hitting is this one: https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/blob/master/vertx-core/src/main/java/io/vertx/core/http/impl/Http2UpgradeClientConnection.java#L434 .

And it's hardcoded in Vert.x.

Maybe a reproducer could help understanding why you're hitting this limit.

/cc @vietj

I'll try to add a reproducer, but can't guarantee, as I can't add here the endpoint server (private, proprietary). It only happens with specific endpoint servers, where the http/2 was enabled.

But if I set:
quarkus.rest-client.alpn=true
#quarkus.rest-client.http2=true

it works fine, but then how can I know what http version the quarkus rest client is using (http 1.1 or http/2) ?
The quarkus.rest-client.alpn enabled should negotiate the http protocol, so I understand http/2 should still be used (as server supports it).
@vietj @cescoffier is there a reason why the frame size is not configurable and instead it's hard coded as @gsmet points out?
no specific reason, it should be made configurable.

issue.title: Introduce an option for HTTP/2 upgrade max content length
